scope: Full SHA-2 family article: FIPS 180-4's six algorithms, the 32-bit and 64-bit word sizes, IV and constant derivations, padding, message schedules, 64/80-round compression, truncation and SHA-512/t IV generation, the FIPS 180-2 history, NIST approval and security-strength guidance, HMAC-SHA-2 test vectors, and the length-extension limitation. No completion claim for SHA-1, SHA-3, MD5, HMAC as a standalone entity, HKDF, TLS, any protocol, or any implementation.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 FIPS 180-4 的 SHA-2 家族：六个成员的摘要/块/字/轮数参数、填充与 64/128 位大端长度、素数平方根/立方根产生的 IV 与轮常量、Ch/Maj/Σ/σ 函数、64/80 字消息表、64/80 轮压缩、回加与截断、SHA-512/t IV 生成函数；覆盖 FIPS 180-2 的 2002/2004 历史、RFC 6234 的代码与测试向量、RFC 4231 的 HMAC-SHA-2 向量、SP 800-107 的安全强度与截断规则、SP 800-131A 的批准状态，以及长度扩展边界。不把 SHA-1、SHA-3、HMAC、HKDF 或整个哈希家族并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers FIPS 180-4's SHA-2 family: the six members' digest/block/word/round parameters, padding and the 64/128-bit big-endian length, IVs and round constants derived from square and cube roots of primes, the Ch/Maj/Σ/σ functions, the 64/80-word schedule, the 64/80-round compression, feed-forward and truncation, and the SHA-512/t IV generation function; the FIPS 180-2 2002/2004 history, RFC 6234 code and test vectors, RFC 4231 HMAC-SHA-2 vectors, SP 800-107 security strengths and truncation rules, SP 800-131A approval, and the length-extension boundary. It does not absorb SHA-1, SHA-3, HMAC, HKDF or the whole hash family.

entry.relatedPolicy: These are distinct catalog entities. They are linked for context only and are not aliases, merged identities or completed by this article. SHA-1 is the predecessor family; MD5 is the earlier MD-family design; SHA-3 is a separate sponge-based family; FIPS 180-4 is the standard document; HMAC is the construction whose SHA-2 instantiation is discussed here. The term--sha-2 record was merged into sha2 in this round.
